items.exampleEn: My parents gave me a small microscope for my tenth birthday.
items.exampleZh: 爸媽送我小型顯微鏡當作十歲生日禮物。

items.exampleEn: Her high school diploma hangs in a frame in the living room.
items.exampleZh: 她的高中畢業證書裱框掛在客廳裡。

items.exampleEn: The sugar refinery near the port has closed after eighty years.
items.exampleZh: 港口附近的製糖廠在營運八十年後關閉了。

items.exampleEn: The guest lecturer flew in from abroad to give a single talk.
items.exampleZh: 那位客座講師專程從國外飛來，只為了演講一場。

items.exampleEn: New staff spend their first week familiarizing themselves with the company's systems.
items.exampleZh: 新進員工第一週都在熟悉公司的系統。

items.exampleEn: The city library is a center of learning for people of all ages.
items.exampleZh: 市立圖書館是各年齡層的人學習的中心。

items.exampleEn: My cousin has mastered three card tricks and shows them at every party.
items.exampleZh: 我的表親已經熟練了三個紙牌魔術，每次派對都會表演。

items.exampleEn: The mayor was quoted as saying that the new bridge would open in May.
items.exampleZh: 據引述，市長說新橋將在五月啟用。

items.sentenceEn: You need time to master a new language, so don't give up.
items.sentenceZh: 精通一門新語言需要時間，所以別放棄。

items.audioEn: The lecturer is sick today, so this afternoon's class will be moved to Friday.
items.audioZh: 講師今天生病了，所以今天下午的課會改到星期五。

items.sentenceEn: In biology class, we looked at a drop of pond water under the microscope.
items.sentenceZh: 生物課上，我們用顯微鏡觀察一滴池塘水。

items.sentenceEn: My essay begins with a short quote from a famous writer.
items.sentenceZh: 我的文章以一位名作家的一小段引文開頭。

items.stemEn: Before the trip, please ____ yourself with the map of the old town.
items.stemZh: 出發前，請先熟悉老城區的地圖。

items.stemEn: After four years of study, he finally received his ____ at the graduation ceremony.
items.stemZh: 讀了四年書，他終於在畢業典禮上拿到畢業證書。

items.passageEn: Our class took a field trip to a technical college last week. A friendly lecturer showed us around the labs. In one room, students were looking at plant cells under a microscope. In another, they studied how an oil refinery turns oil from the ground into fuel. The lecturer quoted an old saying: 'Learning never exhausts the mind.' She explained that it takes years to master a skill, but every step counts. Before we left, she encouraged us to familiarize ourselves with different careers. One student said he wanted to earn a diploma in engineering, just like his grandfather, who is a legend in his family.
items.passageZh: 上週我們班去一所技術學院校外教學。一位親切的講師帶我們參觀實驗室。在一間教室裡，學生正用顯微鏡觀察植物細胞。另一間則在研究煉油廠如何把原油變成燃料。講師引用了一句老話：「學習永遠不會讓頭腦疲倦。」她說明，要精通一項技能得花好幾年，但每一步都算數。離開前，她鼓勵我們多去熟悉各種職業。一位同學說他想拿到工程學的文憑，就像他爺爺一樣，他爺爺是他們家族裡的傳奇人物。

options: 每個人都該念工程學系
學習永遠不會讓頭腦疲倦
顯微鏡是最重要的工具

items.promptZh: 這家工廠給了我們一個新設備的報價。
referenceEn: The factory gave us a quote for the new equipment.
We got a quote from the factory for the new machine.
rubricZh: quote 當名詞可指「報價」（例如 a quote for…）
時態合理即可（例如 gave、has given）

items.promptZh: 線上學習讓很多上班族可以在家進修。
referenceEn: Online learning lets many office workers study at home.
Online learning allows many working people to study from home.
rubricZh: learning 當名詞指「學習」（例如 online learning 等）
「讓…可以」可寫，例如 let… study、allow… to study 等
「上班族」可寫，例如 office workers、working people 等
